maddeler.e:
ترووقت (form VI)
# تُرُووِقْتُ (turūwiqtu) /tu.ruː.wiq.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَرَاوَقَ (tarāwaqa)
# تُرُووِقْتَ (turūwiqta) /tu.ruː.wiq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَرَاوَقَ (tarāwaqa)
# تُرُووِقْتِ (turūwiqti) /tu.ruː.wiq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَرَاوَقَ (tarāwaqa)
# تُرُووِقَتْ (turūwiqat) /tu.ruː.wi.qat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
